title: UFO that came down through redwood trees at a 45-degree angle
place_text: Northern California or Oregon, redwood forest

tellings.quote: So, Jacques Vallée told me about this case that really got me thinking, and it was somewhere in like northern California or or or Oregon, you know, where there's there's these tall redwood trees. And he said the witnesses said that the UFO had come down at a 45-degree angle, and he said left some marks on the ground.

plain: Somewhere among the tall redwoods of northern California or Oregon, witnesses said, a UFO came down at a 45-degree angle and left marks on the ground. Rizwan Virk, an MIT scientist, tells Michels that he heard about the case from the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, and that it "really got me thinking." He gives no date or names for the witnesses.
